requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify management for SMBs, both today and in the future.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need easy-to-use, efficient solutions to manage their printers without dedicated IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solution development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available for productivity, scan workflow, and device management; tested with SMB user group and validated to reduce management time by at least 30%.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 7, Page 10, Page 11

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO for SMB Segment
requirements.Description: Magellan must deliver the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for SMBs compared to other HP business printers, with minimal intervention required.
requirements.Rationale: Cost-efficiency is a top priority for SMBs, and minimizing intervention reduces downtime and support needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain optimization, efficient ink tank design, and robust hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis demonstrates Magellan has the lowest TCO in its class; maintenance intervals are at least 20% longer than previous models.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by customers (PHA), with a fallback to service center replacement (MINK) if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime for SMB customers without IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and packaging design for easy replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 80% of maintenance box replacements can be performed by end-users without assistance; instructions provided and validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure correct color placement.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and potential damage, reducing support incidents.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, BA, Tech Reg
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 100% of test users are unable to insert the wrong bottle in the wrong tank; passes HP QA and regulatory testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for managing multiple printers and devices, tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs with limited IT support need a simple, centralized management tool.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend integration, UI/UX design, and device telemetry.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports management of at least 15 devices, provides actionable alerts, and is validated by SMB user group for usability.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKUs must support HP's SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategy to accelerate PaaS adoption and value-added solutions for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP cloud and service platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU passes solution certification for SMB2.0, Advanced View, and PaaS support.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Compatibility
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19), support PDL/PS, and meet Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive performance and compliance for managed office environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware optimization, Blue Angel certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves required print speeds, passes PDL/PS compatibility tests, and receives Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-driven 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' features for superior output quality and ease of use.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan with advanced, user-friendly print and scan experiences.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software development and hardware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available in product UI; user testing shows at least 20% improvement in output quality and ease of use over previous models.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the printer's plastic content is made from recycled materials, exceeding key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses increasing demand for sustainable products and differentiates from competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and validation of recycled materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party audit confirm at least 60% RCP; sustainability claim validated by HP and external certifiers.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design the printer for minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over its lifecycle (subject to ongoing investigation).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces operational costs and downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field data shows at least 15% reduction in maintenance events compared to previous HP SMB printers.

requirements.Title: Comprehensive Telemetry Support
requirements.Description: Implement robust telemetry to support remote diagnostics, predictive maintenance, and usage analytics for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support and enhances device manageability for customers with limited IT resources.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accessible via SMB portal and HP support tools; validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and integration with the HP App for easy setup, printing, and device management.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern SMB workflows and BYOD environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is discoverable and manageable via HP App; passes mobile printing certification tests.
